source_candidate.claim_under_test: VeriRego implementation existence and stated source URL are thesis-backed, while current repository content is unavailable/unverified.

observations: Brno University of Technology lists Jan Hranicka's 2025/2026 master's thesis Analysis of Access Control Policies, defended 2026-06-22 with grade A.
The abstract states that the proposed analyses were implemented in VeriRego and detected inconsistencies and dead code in Rego policies.
The supervisor/reviewer record states that source code for VeriRego was submitted as a Git repository and the prototype was demonstrated.
The implementation chapter describes VeriRego as a Go tool developed by the VeriFIT research group, reusing OPA parsing infrastructure and implementing type analysis plus Rego-to-SMT policy analyses.
The thesis explicitly states the source URL https://github.com/VeriFIT/VeriRego.
